description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives are to increase access to primary education, and the quality of teaching for literacy and numeracy, and to strengthen key management systems

The development objectives of Improving Learning Outcomes Project for Chad are to increase access to primary education, and the quality of teaching for literacy and numeracy, and to strengthen key management system. This project has five components. 1) The first component, Strengthening the quality of teaching, has the following sub-components: (i) Strengthening the ENIB preservice teacher training system; (ii) Increasing teacher effectiveness for literacy and numeracy in grades 1–3; and (iii) Supporting literacy acquisition. 2) The second component, Improving access to learning, has the following sub-components: (i) Improving learning environments; and (ii) Expanding opportunities for students to learn. 3) The third component, Strengthening recruitment and financing of teachers, aims to strengthen the recruitment and financing of teachers. 4) The fourth component, Capacity building, project management, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), has the following sub-components: (i) Technical assistance and institutional capacity strengthening of MENPC; and (ii) Support project management, M&E activities. 5) The fifth component, Contingent Emergency Response (CERC), is included to help improve response times should a situation arise where urgent assistance is needed.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section 1.A.2. The Recipient shall establish within thirty (30) days of the Effective Date, and thereafter maintainthroughout Project implementation, a high-level Committee, chaired by the Minister of MENPC or his/her representative, andintegrated, inter alia, by representatives of the Recipient's ministry in charge of economy, the planning of development (MEPDCI),the ministry in charge of finance and budget (MFB), the ministry in charge of public service (MFPECS), representatives from thenational federation of parent-teacher associations and a teachers union, all selected pursuant to criteria set forth in the PIM.The Project Steering Committee shall be responsible for overseeing the implementation of the Project, approving the Annual WorkPlan and Budget, as well as the Project progress reports, and ensure that the Project objectives are being met.
Schedule 2, Section I. A.3. The Recipient shall, within six (6) months from the Effective Date, hire a civil engineer; a teachertraining expert; and a PBC coordinator.

Schedule 2, Section I.C.1. The Recipient shall, not later than two (2) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter by November30 of each year during the implementation of the Project, starting November 30, 2022 prepare and furnish to the Association for itsapproval, the annual work plan and budget containing all proposed activities for inclusion in the Project until December 31, 2022,and in each case thereafter for the following calendar year, including a set of Eligible Expenditures Subject toPerformance-Based-Condition Targets (EESPBCTs), in line with the PIM, together with the financing plan for such activities and atimetable for their implementation.

title.narrative: Increase in percentage of grade 2 students who score at least 80 percent in literacy

comment.narrative: The percentage is the number of second grade students who score 80 percent or greater on a literacy assessment expressed as a percentage of second grade students who take the assessment. This threshold (students answering 80 percent of the questions correctly to be counted as having an appropriate preparedness for learning) is aligned with the GEPD. The increase refers to the percentage found at endline minus the percentage found at baseline. The target is expressed in percentage points, i.e. an increase at endline of 8 percentage points over the baseline value.
